objectives.title: Speak With the Ferrywoman
objectives.hint: She is beaching her boat by the fire at the tide-line, below the barrow field.

happening.text: The party meets the Ferrywoman at her tide-line fire and learns why she still keeps the old crossing schedule.
happening.subject: npc/ferrywoman

objectives.title: Cross the Barrow Field
objectives.hint: The gatehouse stands north across the graves. You can leave the armored shape kneeling among the barrows where it is — the ground is wide on either side of it.

happening.text: The party crosses the barrow field, past the kneeling armored shape, to the gatehouse approach.
happening.subject: anchor/l0-gate-approach

on_rest.text: The driftwood fire settles, and for a while neither the tide nor the graves make a sound.

obj/ashore.text: A fire is lit at the tide-line. Rest at a fire and it will hold your place — but the keep forgets nothing it has already sent against you.

happening.text: The Barrow Warden takes its kneeling place among the barrows, athwart the path to the gate.
happening.subject: npc/barrow-warden

on_complete.text: The portcullis ahead rises and falls to a rhythm nothing living is keeping.

happening.text: The party lands on the barrow shore, takes up class and kit at the tide-line fire, and crosses the graves to the gate.

npc/ferrywoman.doing: beaching her boat by the driftwood fire, waiting to send the newest crossing up the barrow field

npc/sexton.doing: sweeping the cold chapel hearth, keeping the vigil he's kept for years, waiting on visitors he no longer expects

npc/barrow-warden.doing: kneeling among the barrows, sword point-down, unmoved since the graves were filled

objectives.title: Pass the Portcullis
objectives.hint: Stand in the watch arch and count the gate's rhythm before you step. It does not slow down for anyone.

happening.text: The party reads the portcullis's rhythm and crosses on an open beat.
happening.subject: anchor/l1a-ward

objectives.title: Climb the Worn Stair
objectives.hint: The treads are worn smooth down the middle — by what, exactly? The alcove halfway up is deeper than it looks.

happening.text: The party climbs the boulder stair's polished centre lane and reaches the stair-head, the spill-shaft shortcut visible below.
happening.subject: anchor/l1a-stair-head

obj/the-stair.text: From the stair-head you can see the spill-shaft ladder dropping back to the barrow fire. The stair kept its toll; the keep pays out its change in shortcuts.

happening.text: The party reads the portcullis's rhythm, crosses on an open beat, and climbs the boulder stair to the wall.

npc/ferrywoman.doing: still minding the tide-line fire, watching the graves for a party she already sent up them

npc/sexton.doing: still sweeping the chapel hearth, unseen by a party crossing the barrow field and climbing the worn stair

npc/barrow-warden.doing: kneeling among the barrows, sword point-down, unmoved since the graves were filled

objectives.title: Walk the Wall
objectives.hint: The wall walk runs open to the sky. The keep's wardens stood their posts here; some of them have not stopped.

happening.text: The party walks the open wall-walk and survives the sentinel posted there since the wardens hollowed.
happening.subject: actor/wall-sentinel

objectives.title: Find the Sexton
objectives.hint: An old man sweeps a cold hearth in the chapel across the courtyard.

happening.text: The party finds the Sexton sweeping his cold hearth in the chapel and learns the keep still has a caretaker.
happening.subject: npc/sexton

on_rest.text: The Chapel Hearth takes the flame as if it had only been waiting for someone to ask.

obj/the-hearth.text: The chapel's side door is barred from the other side.

happening.text: The party walks the open wall-walk and finds the Sexton keeping his cold hearth in the chapel.

npc/ferrywoman.doing: keeping the tide-line fire lit, listening for a bell she has not yet heard

npc/sexton.doing: sweeping the hearth, about to watch the door open at last on the party crossing his threshold

npc/barrow-warden.doing: kneeling among the barrows, sword point-down, unmoved since the graves were filled

objectives.title: Go Down the Drowned Way
objectives.hint: Through the undercroft door, a ledge overhangs the flooded cistern. The drop is the only way down, and it is a door that closes itself behind you.

happening.text: The party drops through the undercroft door into the flooded cistern, the only way down.
happening.subject: anchor/l3-shallows

objectives.title: Reach the Barred Door's Far Side
objectives.hint: Past the pillars, past the shallows, up the far climb. The dart gallery over the exit stair has a lever behind a grate on the far side of it.

happening.text: The party survives the cistern pillars' ambush and lifts the bar sealing the far door, from the inside.
happening.subject: anchor/l3-unlock

objectives.title: Return to the Hearth
objectives.hint: The bar lifts from this side. It will never fall again.

happening.text: The party returns to the Sexton through the door they just opened, and he sets his broom aside.
happening.subject: npc/sexton

obj/the-drop.text: Cold to the waist. The water remembers the bell better than the keep does — something in it still keeps time.

on_complete.text: The Sexton looks at the open side door for a long moment, and sets his broom against the wall.

happening.text: The party descends into the flooded cistern and lifts the chapel's barred side door from the inside, for good.
happening.subject: anchor/l3-shortcut-a

npc/ferrywoman.doing: minding the fire and the empty boat, the crossing schedule unchanged by what is happening under the keep

npc/sexton.doing: waiting by the newly-lit chapel hearth for the party to come back up from the drowned way

npc/barrow-warden.doing: kneeling among the barrows, sword point-down, unmoved since the graves were filled

objectives.title: Strike the Cracked Bell
objectives.hint: The old alarm bell hangs cracked in the chapel. The Sexton says the wardens remember it. He does not say it as encouragement.

happening.text: The party strikes the cracked alarm bell, and the keep's gate and wall breaches answer by falling open.
happening.subject: anchor/l2-cracked-bell

objectives.title: Hold the Gate Breach
objectives.hint: They come through the gate breach in marching order, armed, remembering the drill.

happening.text: The party holds the gate breach against two Hollow Gate-Warders marching in remembered drill order.
happening.subject: wave/gate-assault

objectives.title: Hold the Wall Breach
objectives.hint: The gate column is down, and the wall breach answers with the second — the keep sends its wardens the way it always drilled them: in waves.

happening.text: The party holds the wall breach against the second wave the keep sends the way it always drilled.
happening.subject: wave/wall-assault

objectives.title: Lay the Grave Echoes
objectives.hint: The breaches are quiet, and still something arrives — straight out of the grave-soil, at the edge of what it can sense.

happening.text: The party lays the grave echoes that rise at the edge of what the keep can still sense.
happening.subject: wave/grave-echoes

happening.text: The gate breach falls open at the bell's alarm.
happening.subject: anchor/l2-breach-gate

happening.text: The wall breach falls open at the same stroke.
happening.subject: anchor/l2-breach-wall

happening.text: The Hollow Gate-Warders arrive through the open breach, marching in remembered drill order.
happening.subject: wave/gate-assault

happening.text: The Grave Echoes rise out of the grave-soil at the muster yard's edge.
happening.subject: wave/grave-echoes

happening.text: The Hollow Wall-Warder arrives through the wall breach, the keep's second answer.
happening.subject: wave/wall-assault

on_complete.text: A different quiet comes back. Above you, in the tower, something heavy resumes its round.

happening.text: The party strikes the cracked alarm bell and holds the courtyard through three waves of the keep's remembered drill.

npc/ferrywoman.doing: still at her fire on the shore, too far below to hear the alarm bell but not the courtyard answering it

npc/sexton.doing: standing by after saying his piece — the door is open, the alarm about to sound, the fight not his to fight

npc/barrow-warden.doing: kneeling among the barrows, sword point-down, unmoved since the graves were filled

objectives.title: Climb to the Rope Room
objectives.hint: The tower stair rises from the cistern's far landing. The rope room above holds a cold fire-bowl.

happening.text: The party climbs the tower stair to the rope room and lights its small, steady fire.
happening.subject: anchor/l4-rope-room

objectives.title: Enter the Bell Loft
objectives.hint: Stop at the loft door before you walk in. Look up. Count the rafters, and what the rafters hold.

happening.text: The party reaches the bell loft door and counts the rafters, and what waits on them.
happening.subject: anchor/l4-loft

objectives.title: End the Keeper's Watch
objectives.hint: It walks the ring around the bell pit and has never once broken step. Watch a full round from the door — then choose where the round is thinnest.

happening.text: The Bellkeeper falls, its endless round around the bell pit finally broken.
happening.subject: wave/bellkeeper

on_rest.text: The rope room fire burns small and steady, the way a fire burns before work.

happening.text: The Bellkeeper's round resumes overhead, heavy and unbroken, the moment the rope-room fire catches.
happening.subject: wave/bellkeeper

happening.text: The Bellkeeper falls on its own ring, and its endless round around the bell pit finally ends.
happening.subject: wave/bellkeeper

npc/ferrywoman.doing: minding the tide-line fire, counting a longer wait than she has counted in years

npc/sexton.doing: keeping his hearth while the tower above answers the alarm he warned would come

npc/barrow-warden.doing: kneeling among the barrows, sword point-down, unmoved since the graves were filled

objectives.title: Raise the Drowned Bell
objectives.hint: The yoke over the pit is empty. Haul the drowned bell home to it.

happening.text: The party hauls the drowned bell home to its empty yoke, and the keep gains back the one thing it lost.
happening.subject: item/drowned-bell

objectives.title: Take the Bell Rope Down
objectives.hint: The grate over the pit stands open. The rope falls twenty-two blocks into the well it was hauled from — step off, or take the stairs if your knees object. The climb is over either way.

happening.text: The party takes the bell rope down, off the ring and through the drop, to the rope room below.
happening.subject: anchor/l4-rope-foot

objectives.title: Tell the Ferrywoman
objectives.hint: Bells carry over water, and she rows by the old bell-times. The tide-gate by the rope room stands open; her boat is at the pier below.

happening.text: The party finds the Ferrywoman waiting at the pier, already rowed around on the first true stroke, and tells her the bell is home.
happening.subject: npc/ferrywoman-pier

happening.text: The grate over the bell pit falls open, the rope drop finally a way down instead of a warning.
happening.subject: anchor/l4-rope-drop

happening.text: Far below, iron grinds off the tide-gate — the sea is told to open the door shut on its side of the ledger.
happening.subject: anchor/l4-tide-gate

obj/raise-it.text: Under the first true stroke the grate over the pit falls open, and somewhere below, iron grinds off the tide-gate. The sea has been told to open the door.

happening.text: The Ferrywoman leaves her tide-line fire, off toward the pier, called by the first true stroke.
happening.subject: npc/ferrywoman

happening.text: The Ferrywoman is waiting at the pier, having rowed around the headland the moment the bell carried.
happening.subject: npc/ferrywoman-pier

happening.text: The tide obeys the raised bell, and the party's crossing is done.
The bell's return seals the tide's old debt to the keep, and the crossing the Ferrywoman kept open for years is finally answered.

npc/ferrywoman.doing: minding the tide-line fire one more time, listening for the stroke she has waited years to hear

npc/sexton.doing: keeping the chapel hearth, the bell's business finally out of his hands

npc/barrow-warden.doing: kneeling among the barrows, sword point-down, unmoved since the graves were filled

on_unlock.text: The bar lifts. This door does not close again.

happening.text: The kneeling Barrow Warden is gone from the barrows the instant it is struck.
happening.subject: npc/barrow-warden

happening.text: The Barrow Warden's real twin stands up where the puppet knelt, armored and answering.
happening.subject: actor/barrow-warden

happening.text: It gains a target — whoever struck it — and gives chase for the first time in years.
happening.subject: actor/barrow-warden

effects.text: The Barrow Warden rises out of its kneel, unhurried, like a man standing up from a grave he dug himself, and answers the question you asked.

happening.text: The Wall-Sentinel is standing the parapet mid-walk, exactly where the wardens posted it, as the party steps into range.
happening.subject: actor/wall-sentinel

happening.text: It gains its post's old orders back and turns on whoever just walked the open wall.
happening.subject: actor/wall-sentinel

happening.text: A Pillar-Warden is posted among the cistern pillars, axe in hand, as the party nears the item alcove.
happening.subject: actor/pillar-warden-a

happening.text: A second Pillar-Warden stands its own pillar beside the first.
happening.subject: actor/pillar-warden-b

happening.text: It gains motion and swings for whoever reached the alcove.
happening.subject: actor/pillar-warden-a

happening.text: It gains motion at the same instant, closing the pincer.
happening.subject: actor/pillar-warden-b

happening.text: A husk is perched on the loft rafters as the party reaches the doorway.
happening.subject: actor/rafter-1

happening.text: A second husk perches the rafter opposite it.
happening.subject: actor/rafter-2

happening.text: It gains its footing and drops from the rafter into the fight.
happening.subject: actor/rafter-1

happening.text: It drops with it, off the opposite rafter.
happening.subject: actor/rafter-2
